mechanism: Propafenone is a Class IC antiarrhythmic that blocks sodium channels; hyperkalemia enhances this effect and increases risk of cardiac conduction abnormalities, arrhythmias, and sudden cardiac death.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; maintain potassium in normal range (3.5-5.0 mEq/L); adjust potassium supplementation based on levels and ECG changes; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring.
